description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named UserSearchFilterParams, extending a base class FilterParams. It encapsulates filtering parameters for searching users within an HR management system, including fields like username, status, user role, employee number, and password presence, along with associated getter and setter methods.

classes.name: UserSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for capturing search filter parameters for user queries in an HR management system.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status filter (boolean or null).

methods.name: getUserRoleId
methods.description: Retrieves the user role ID filter value.

methods.name: setUserRoleId
methods.description: Sets the user role ID filter parameter.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number filter value.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: hasPassword
methods.description: Checks if the presence of a password is a filter criterion.

methods.name: setHasPassword
methods.description: Sets the password presence filter parameter.
